lesson: A committed .factory/ceremony-target redirects EVERY AskUserQuestion round from this checkout into another repo's story ledger, and the other repo's rounds appear in yours. It is tracked, so clearing it in one worktree does nothing until that clear reaches master - a task worktree cut from master gets the stale pointer back and silently misfiles its rounds again. Symptoms: record_grill_from_json.py refuses with 'round does not match an AskUserQuestion ledger record' naming a question from an unrelated story. Check 'cat .factory/ceremony-target' in EVERY new task worktree, and never grep the newest round by timestamp - grep for your own question text and verify session_id.
source: ask-period-control tasks 2 and 3: rounds ledgered into 3oilpalm-multi-plant twice, and a multi-plant round was picked up as this task's round by a newest-by-timestamp lookup
